newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mondragon drops 4.84 pct in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Mondragon drops 4.84 pct in Manila.

text.p: Leisure and retail firm Mondragon International Philippines Inc lost 75 centavos to 14.75 pesos by midtrade in Manila on Wednesday on talk of lower than expected earnings from its casino in its first few weeks of operations, brokers said.

"Earnings concerns, such as talk that Mondragon's casino may not be able to meet its initial earnings target in its first month of operation due to the absence of the high rollers, dampened interest on the issue," one broker said.
Mondragon's Mimosa casino at the Clark economic zone north of Manila opened on September 27.
Officials of the company were not immediately available for comment.
Some 421,800 shares of Mondragon changed hands.
